verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs describe comprehensive code review features on a PR screen, including reviewing large diffs and viewing third-party code reports. An AI code reviewer also reviews changes and suggests fixes, which confirms pull requests and diff comparison are core features. missing for 10: explicit documentation of human inline review comments on specific lines, detailed PR workflow docs (opening/creating a PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience.
